test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of February 2025, how many youth were trained in vocational skills under the Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan initiatives?
solution:
The correct answer is __**28,275**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **28,275 youth** were trained in vocational skills under the **Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS)** initiatives as of February 2025.
 
• The Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India.
 
• NYKS works to promote and develop the personality and leadership qualities of rural youth through **skill development and vocational training programs**.
 
• The training programs aim to make youth employable by equipping them with market-relevant skills.
 
• These initiatives contribute to the government's focus on **empowering youth and enhancing their employability** through skill-building efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS)**

 
 
• Established in 1972, NYKS is one of the largest youth organizations in the world.
 
• Its primary goal is to involve rural youth in the nation-building process and provide opportunities for skill development.
 
• It organizes diverse programs such as **vocational training, sports, cultural activities, and awareness campaigns**.
 
 
 
• **Vocational Training**
 
 
• Vocational training refers to education that focuses on providing students with practical skills and knowledge required for a specific trade or profession.
 
• It is critical for enhancing employability, especially among youth, in both formal and informal sectors.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development Initiatives in India**
 
 
• The Government of India has introduced various programs such as **Skill India Mission, Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), and Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)** to bridge the skill gap in the country.
 
• These programs aim to train millions of youth in industry-specific skills, ensuring their employability and contribution to economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for overseeing youth development and sports activities in India.
 
• It supports initiatives like NYKS, National Service Scheme (NSS), and Khelo India to nurture talent and promote holistic development.
